sourceTitle: Cranberry Turkey Cutlets With Fresh Chavrie
sourceText:
Cranberry Turkey Cutlets With Fresh Chavrie
By: Corrinne
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 5:01pm

Ingredients




1 package (17.6 oz) turkey cutlets
4 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil
1 package 5.3 oz. Chavrie® Pyramid
1/4 cup finely chopped pecans
5 tablespoons whole berry cranberry sauce

Preparation

1 Heat broiler. Brush one side of cutlets with olive oil; place oiled side down on broiler pan. Brush tops with remaining olive oil. 2 Broil about 4 inches from heat for 5 minutes. Turn and broil 3 minutes or until no longer pink in center. 3 Meanwhile, mix Chavrie® and pecans in small bowl. Spoon mixture over top of broiled cutlets and broil and additional minute or until cheese is warm. 4 Top with cranberry sauce.

About


Turkey topped with creamy fresh goat cheese and tangy, sweet cranberries.  Just perfect for Thanksgiving dinner!
